title: Planes Still Have Ashtrays And It's Not An Oversight

scenes.narration: Smoking has been banned on flights for decades, and there is still an ashtray built into the airplane bathroom door.
scenes.note: The contradiction up front: a NO SMOKING sign and an ashtray in the same frame.

scenes.narration: It is not a leftover nobody removed. Regulators require it, and a plane can be held on the ground over a broken one.
scenes.note: Gus arrives with a clipboard. The ashtray is required equipment — stamp it, do not joke about it.

scenes.narration: The reasoning is bleak and completely correct.

scenes.narration: Somebody is eventually going to smoke in there anyway, and the only question is where the cigarette ends up.
